pages.title: Small Totoro Searching for Acorns Beneath a Camphor Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro searches for acorns beneath a camphor tree on this printable coloring page, looking down at the nuts scattered among leaves and exposed roots. Textured acorn caps, bark lines, and grass blades add fine details around his large, simple body shape.

pages.title: Small Totoro Carrying an Acorn Along a Woodland Path Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro carries an acorn along a woodland path on this printable coloring page, stepping forward with the large nut held in both little paws. A curving trail, overhanging leaves, tree trunk, and rounded bushes frame the central figure without crowding his outline.

pages.title: Small Totoro Peeking Through Tall Grass as Mei Discovers Him Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro peeks through tall grass as Mei discovers him on this printable coloring page, standing below the long leaves she parts with one hand. Her surprised expression and pigtails rise behind him, with overlapping blades and low plants filling the foreground.

pages.title: Small Totoro Disappearing From Sight While Mei Watches Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro disappears from sight while Mei watches on this printable coloring page, his body shown with a dotted outline as she crouches nearby. Short radiating lines emphasize the change, while the tree trunk, leafy plants, and pebbles give the scene an outdoor setting.

pages.title: Small Totoro Darting Beneath the Kusakabe House Porch Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro darts beneath the Kusakabe house porch on this printable coloring page, running between wooden supports with a lifted foot and short motion lines. Long beams and floorboards form large angular sections above him, while stones and grass add smaller ground details.

pages.title: Small Totoro Meeting Soot Sprites Under the Old House Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro meets soot sprites under the old house on this printable coloring page, facing two round, spiky creatures beside the porch's heavy wooden supports. Rocks, fallen leaves, and grass cover the ground, contrasting with the straight beams and broad body outlines.

pages.title: Small Totoro Following Acorns Spilling From Chu Totoro's Sack Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro follows acorns spilling from Chu Totoro's sack on this printable coloring page, walking behind him as the nuts fall onto the woodland path. The larger creature's patterned belly and shoulder sack stand beside the little follower, with a tree and bushes behind them.

pages.title: Small Totoro Running Through the Garden with Mei Chasing Him Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro runs through the garden with Mei chasing him on this printable coloring page, her outstretched hand reaching toward his pointed ears and rounded body. Climbing flowers on a tied wooden trellis, leafy bushes, and scattered grass make a detailed border around their path.

pages.title: Small Totoro Leading Mei Through a Tunnel of Tangled Branches Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro leads Mei through a tunnel of tangled branches on this printable coloring page, stepping along a narrow path beneath an arch of overlapping limbs. Her shoulder bag and smiling face remain clearly visible among the many leaves, stems, and scattered ground stones.

pages.title: Small Totoro Entering the Hidden Hollow Beneath the Camphor Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro enters the hidden hollow beneath the camphor tree on this printable coloring page, walking toward an opening enclosed by large curving roots and bark. A few stones and leafy shoots mark the narrow trail, leaving broad areas within the tree and creature outlines.

pages.title: Small Totoro Beside Mei as She Discovers Sleeping Big Totoro Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro stands beside Mei as she discovers sleeping Big Totoro on this printable coloring page, inside a hollow framed by twisting roots and leaves. Mei looks up at the sleeper's closed eyes, broad belly, and large clawed feet while her tiny guide waits nearby.

pages.title: Small Totoro Resting Beside Mei on Big Totoro's Belly Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro rests beside Mei on Big Totoro's belly on this printable coloring page, sitting upright while she sleeps with one arm around the little creature. Big Totoro's closed eyes, belly markings, paws, and surrounding grass create a quiet scene with spacious central shapes.

pages.title: Small Totoro Perched on Big Totoro's Head Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro perches on Big Totoro's head on this printable coloring page, sitting between the larger creature's pointed ears as both face forward against a plain background. Big Totoro's whiskers, belly chevrons, claws, and rounded foot pads add clearly separated details.

pages.title: Small Totoro Standing Beside Chu Totoro and Big Totoro Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro stands beside Chu Totoro and Big Totoro on this printable coloring page, forming a group of three differently sized figures on a grassy patch. Their round eyes and pointed ears repeat across the picture, with whiskers and belly markings on the larger pair.

pages.title: Small Totoro Inspecting Mei's Bamboo-leaf Seed Gift Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro inspects Mei's bamboo-leaf seed gift on this printable coloring page, looking down at an opened bundle of acorns resting on the ground before him. Long folded leaves, a knotted tie, patterned acorn caps, and sparse plants provide small details around his broad silhouette.

pages.title: Small Totoro Joining the Moonlit Seed-growing Dance Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro joins the moonlit seed-growing dance on this printable coloring page, lifting a foot beside Chu Totoro and Big Totoro above a patch of seedlings. A crescent moon and scattered stars hang overhead, while raised arms and curved motion marks show the dance.

pages.title: Small Totoro Watching an Acorn Seedling Break Through the Soil Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro watches an acorn seedling break through the soil on this printable coloring page, looking toward two broad leaves rising from the opened nut nearby. The mound's small stones, the acorn's textured cap, and surrounding grass contrast with his simple rounded body.

pages.title: Small Totoro Beneath the Giant Tree Growing From the Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro stands beneath the giant tree growing from the garden on this printable coloring page, looking up from behind a low fence beside leafy vegetables. The tree's broad trunk and branching canopy dominate the scene, with scattered leaves and grass adding smaller shapes.

pages.title: Small Totoro Riding with Chu Totoro on Big Totoro's Flying Spinning Top Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro rides with Chu Totoro on Big Totoro's flying spinning top on this printable coloring page, perched above the larger creature as they cross the sky. Curved lines surround the striped top, with clouds, fields, distant hills, and tiny houses below.

pages.title: Small Totoro Playing an Ocarina on a Moonlit Tree Branch Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro plays an ocarina on a moonlit tree branch on this printable coloring page, holding the little instrument in both paws beneath a large round moon. Bark lines and clusters of pointed leaves frame his seated body, with small finger holes on the ocarina.

pages.title: Small Totoro Looking Out Through a Catbus Window Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro looks out through a Catbus window on this printable coloring page, sitting on a cushioned seat within the large rounded frame of the opening. Catbus's fur tufts and stripes edge the picture, while clouds and treetops appear through the opposite windows.

pages.title: Small Totoro Greeting Catbus at a Woodland Bus Stop Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro greets Catbus at a woodland bus stop on this printable coloring page, raising one paw beside the round sign as the many-legged creature approaches. Catbus's broad grin, striped legs, roof mice, and long row of windows create distinct details throughout the scene.

pages.title: Small Totoro Sheltering Under Big Totoro's Umbrella in the Rain Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro shelters under Big Totoro's umbrella in the rain on this printable coloring page, standing close beside the larger creature beneath its broad curved canopy. Outlined drops fall around them, and puddles with little splash marks spread across the ground.

pages.title: Small Totoro Balancing a Camphor Leaf on His Head Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro balances a camphor leaf on his head on this printable coloring page, facing forward with the long stem extending beside his pointed ears. The leaf's branching veins provide detail above his round eyes, while a few stones and grass tufts mark the ground.

pages.title: Small Totoro Accepting an Acorn From Mei in the Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro accepts an acorn from Mei in the garden on this printable coloring page, reaching toward the nut resting on her open palm as she sits nearby. Flowers, tall stems, and grass frame the exchange, with broad spaces in her dress and his body.

pages.title: Small Totoro Hiding Beneath Mei's Sunhat at the Forest Entrance Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro hides beneath Mei's sunhat at the forest entrance on this printable coloring page, peeking from under its wide brim beside a large tree trunk. Fine hat lines and a prominent bow contrast with his simple shape, with leaves and stones bordering the path.

pages.title: Small Totoro Following Mei's Footprints Across the Muddy Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro follows Mei's footprints across the muddy garden on this printable coloring page, looking down at a trail of large shoe impressions in the soil. Little sprouts, broad vegetable leaves, pebbles, and irregular earth shapes give the ground plenty of varied sections.

pages.title: Small Totoro Watching Satsuki Plant an Acorn in the Garden Bed Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro watches Satsuki plant an acorn in the garden bed on this printable coloring page, standing beside her as she kneels near several young seedlings. Her lowered hand, the nut's textured cap, and a wooden fence add details around the broad character outlines.

pages.title: Small Totoro Sitting with Mei and Satsuki on the House Veranda Coloring Page

pages.title: Small Totoro Discovering an Acorn Stash Inside a Hollow Stump Coloring Page

pages.title: Small Totoro Nudging a Rolling Acorn Down a Woodland Slope Coloring Page

pages.description: Small Totoro sleeps inside a curled fallen leaf on this printable coloring page, lying back with closed eyes and little feet tucked within its raised edges. Long leaf veins surround his rounded body, with stones, small plants, and a tree root outside the leaf.

pages.title: Small Totoro Looking at His Reflection in a Forest Pool Coloring Page

pages.description: Small Totoro crosses a shallow stream on stepping stones on this printable coloring page, stretching one little foot toward the next broad rock in the water. Curved ripples wrap around the stones, while tall grass and leafy shoots line the stream banks.

pages.title: Small Totoro Watching a Snail Climb a Mossy Rock Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro watches a snail climb a mossy rock on this printable coloring page, leaning toward its spiral shell and raised feelers from the forest floor. Rounded moss patches, long leaves, grass tufts, and scattered pebbles add texture around the two simple figures.

pages.title: Small Totoro with a Butterfly Resting on His Ear Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro has a butterfly resting on his ear on this printable coloring page, looking upward toward its spread wings above his tall pointed silhouette. The butterfly's spots and divided wing sections add fine detail, with a single flower and leafy stem below.

pages.title: Small Totoro Watching a Frog Leap From a Pond Bank Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro watches a frog leap from a pond bank on this printable coloring page, standing behind the jumping animal as it stretches out over the water. Lily pads, circular ripples, smooth stones, and tall grass surround the frog's clearly outlined legs.

pages.description: Small Totoro chases a leaf carried by the autumn wind on this printable coloring page, lifting a foot and looking up beneath a branch beside the path. Sweeping curves show the breeze around the pointed leaves, with more fallen foliage and stones below.

pages.title: Small Totoro Sheltering Beneath a Fern During a Rain Shower Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro shelters beneath a fern during a rain shower on this printable coloring page, sitting under a long arching frond with drops hanging from its leaflets. Slanted rain lines, outlined droplets, and small puddles repeat around the simple central figure.

pages.description: Small Totoro watches dandelion seeds drift across a meadow on this printable coloring page, looking up beside a tall seed head with several tufts floating overhead. The thin stems and radiating seed threads contrast with his broad body, small flowers, and distant rounded bushes.

pages.description: Small Totoro pauses beside a stone Jizo statue on a forest path on this printable coloring page, standing near its base between large trees and leafy plants. The statue's folded hands and closed eyes form clear details above the scattered stones along the trail.

pages.title: Small Totoro Watching Fireflies Around the Camphor Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Small Totoro watches fireflies around the camphor tree on this printable coloring page, sitting beside exposed roots and looking up at the insects beneath a round moon. Small wing shapes and circles dot the open sky, framed by bark lines and overhanging leaves.

pages.description: Small Totoro leaves tiny footprints in fresh woodland snow on this printable coloring page, stepping forward beneath a snow-covered branch and a scattering of outlined flakes. The oval tracks curve behind him, with rounded snowbanks and small capped plants along the sides.

pages.description: Small Totoro watches a woodland bird feed its chicks on this printable coloring page, looking up from beneath the nest on a leafy tree branch. The adult carries a worm above two open beaks, with woven twigs, feather lines, and bark providing finer details.

pages.description: Small Totoro stands beside Big Totoro and a towering sunflower on this printable coloring page, forming a pair beneath its large ring of pointed petals. pages.description: Small Totoro gazes at stars from the Kusakabe house roof on this printable coloring page, sitting on the ridge above neat rows of curved roof tiles. Large and small five-pointed stars fill the open sky, giving the simple scene a few clearly separated shapes.

pages.description: Small Totoro stands in a moonlit forest on this printable coloring page, holding a leaf between two tall trunks beneath a crescent moon and scattered stars. His whiskers, cheek ovals, and belly markings add details, while ferns, rocks, and fallen leaves cover the ground.

pages.description: Small Totoro raises both arms among giant mushrooms on this printable coloring page, smiling beneath their tall spotted caps with a leaf balanced on his head. Radiating gills, long stems, layered plants, and scattered leaves surround his round belly and small clawed feet.

pages.description: Small Totoro stands in a bamboo grove on this printable coloring page, smiling between tall segmented stalks with sparse leaves and a few rocks around their bases. His rounded belly, curved tail, little claws, and bold outer outline remain prominent against the open background.

pages.description: Small Totoro sits near a stone path on this printable coloring page, holding a long leaf stem beside the trail as it winds toward distant trees. Irregular paving stones fill the foreground, with small flowers, leafy plants, and a leaf resting on his head.

pages.description: Small Totoro explores a magical forest on this printable coloring page, holding a mushroom beneath tall trees with a leaf placed between his pointed ears. Stars and loose leaves dot the scene, while mushrooms, ferns, and a winding path create a varied woodland background.

pages.description: Small Totoro stands in a sunflower field on this printable coloring page, holding a leafy sprig among tall flowers that rise above his pointed ears. pages.description: Small Totoro stands near a rice field on this printable coloring page, facing forward on a raised path between rows of plants and water-lined paddies. A small house, distant hills, trees, and clouds fill the background, with repeated rice clumps adding fine details.

pages.description: Small Totoro sits inside a hollow tree on this printable coloring page, framed by a large opening in a trunk covered with knots and flowing bark lines. pages.description: Small Totoro stands among soot sprites on this printable coloring page, raising both arms as round, spiky little figures cluster around his ears and belly. Their paired circular eyes repeat throughout the picture, with a few pebbles and a single grass tuft below.

pages.description: Small Totoro stands in a windy field on this printable coloring page, surrounded by leaning grasses and flowers as loose leaves drift past his whiskered face. Sweeping wind lines cross the scene, with low hills, bushes, and long clouds extending across the background.

pages.description: Small Totoro stands among tall grass on this printable coloring page, smiling in front of a dense fan of long blades, seed heads, and small flowers. His belly markings, whiskers, and curved tail offer simple details within the narrow overlapping plant shapes.

pages.description: Small Totoro sits on a tree branch on this printable coloring page, holding a broad leaf in both paws with little acorns hanging nearby beneath the limb. Bark lines and a few attached leaves give the branch detail against an otherwise open background.

pages.description: Small Totoro stands in a forest clearing on this printable coloring page, carrying a large leaf overhead beside a tree with spreading branches and scattered leaves. Distant hills, low bushes, grass, and rounded stones frame his small feet and wide patterned belly.

pages.description: Small Totoro stands among autumn leaves on this printable coloring page, smiling as different leaf shapes float around his pointed ears and collect at his feet. Lobed, pointed, and oval leaves have clear veins, with small grass patches surrounding his broad belly outline.

pages.description: Small Totoro waves among wildflowers on this printable coloring page, surrounded by daisies, bell-shaped blooms, leafy stems, and grass that rise around his smiling face.
